name: breather
description: Focus timer with health breaks - browser extension

scripts.build:all: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:edge && npm run build:firefox
scripts.check: npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.lint: eslint src tests scripts wxt.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src tests scripts wxt.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.js --fix
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build:chrome
scripts.zip: wxt zip -b chrome && wxt zip -b edge && wxt zip -b firefox
